headline: Avalanche’s MacKinnon, Makar exit game with lower-body injuries
take: Daily Faceoff reports that Nathan MacKinnon and Cale Makar both left Colorado's game on Thursday with lower-body injuries, and no timeline has been given for either. For a team built around two players like these, that's the whole story until there's an update. The Avalanche are 11-6-3 and have taken 55% of the expected goals (the quality of chances), one of the better process numbers around. They've also scored 12.8 more goals than their chances usually return, a finishing edge that runs through their stars. Denver Gazette's Evan Rawal was already writing last week about how poorly Colorado's power play compares with others; that unit would feel this most.
